title: The Famous 1938 Carnegie Hall Jazz Concert
studio_context: Recorded live on 16 January 1938, issued in 1950; Sing, Sing, Sing runs 12:30, with impromptu solos.

drum_performances.name: Gene Krupa
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The Sing, Sing, Sing drummers learn first (Kevin Dorn's 'first drum solo that I ever tried to learn'), and a break that combines his three floor-tom stickings.

tracks.title: Sing, Sing, Sing (live at Carnegie Hall, 1938)

drums.description: The 1938 concert version, twelve minutes, the tom-tom figure stretched under every soloist.
